title: A quasi-DM stack is exactly an algebraic stack admitting a locally quasi-finite flat cover by a scheme
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project — Morphisms of Algebraic Stacks
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file stacks-morphisms.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the author's theorem characterizing quasi-DM algebraic stacks through the existence of a surjective flat locally quasi-finite morphism from a scheme (source lines 4285-4293, label theorem-quasi-DM); the author's own proof at source lines 4295-4403 follows it immediately and is its proof. The proof reduces to the residual gerbe at a finite type point, rewrites it as a quotient of the residue field by the automorphism group of the point, uses the structure of a locally quasi-finite group algebraic space over a field to produce a flat cover with discrete field fibres, and assembles the covers over all finite type points (proof lines 4295-4402). The reduction to a one-point group quotient and the construction of the flat cover are the substance. H3.
